status: Approved requirements; not implemented or cut over.

authorization.source: Direct human request in current conversation
authorization.statement: OK, let's lock those Effect Category rules in for Bella.
authorization.scope: Approves preceding MXF Effect Category rules and shared lookup integration. Effect from MXF remains the next focused review.

agreedBellaRules.inputs: Already qualified MXF MaterialPackage Name and independently established Type; final selected Clip Name and Type after matching/source selection.
agreedBellaRules.encoding: MXF Name decoded as supported UTF-16BE. Output category comes from existing compiled catalogue, not a separate header category scalar or new legacy-text fallback.
agreedBellaRules.lookup: For a confirmed Precompute, reuse existing AvidEffects::lookup once for selected master/name during processing. Reuse Effect and Effect Category for associated rows; recompute after selected inputs change.
agreedBellaRules.behaviour: Keep exact case, validated numeric suffix forms, aliases/localized names, explicit 3DWarp alias and every distinct ambiguous category in catalogue order joined with /.
agreedBellaRules.retention: Owned QString Effect/Effect Category results with necessary compact derived context. Temporary same-master/name reuse; no permanent name cache or source-history framework.
agreedBellaRules.unavailable: Precompute unavailable/unrecognised category displays lowercase unknown. Media/unknown Type category blank. Does not modify independently proven Type or Precompute Category.
agreedBellaRules.exclusions: No additional media read, effect graph, plug-in/resource load or import-settings body solely for this label. No Effect Sequence retained in Bella rows/results/filters/CSV.
agreedBellaRules.identityLimit: Name-derived recognition does not prove the original generating effect ID or active plug-in. Native effect registration is a different input path.
agreedBellaRules.scope: No new cross-source priority/opening policy or measured performance improvement. Preserve the agreed catalogue through a small new adapter.
